reason: The plugin visualizes calculated per-turn and session token costs in the Web UI using provider-reported usage and a configurable local pricing table.

summaries.zh: 在 Web UI 中显示按消息和会话汇总的美元成本，并提供各类 token 用量的悬浮明细。
summaries.en: Displays per-message and session-level USD costs in the Web UI with a hover breakdown of token usage categories.

capabilities: reads provider-reported token usage from conversation events
calculates session and per-turn USD costs using configurable pricing
displays cost badges and hover breakdowns in the Web UI
reads and may initialize a local pricing configuration file
